items.lesson_explanation:
**To be: am, is, are**

Kata kerja “to be” berarti "adalah / berada". Bentuknya berubah mengikuti subjek:
- I → **am**  (I am a student.)
- He / She / It → **is**  (She is happy. It is cold.)
- You / We / They → **are**  (They are friends.)

**Negatif:** tambahkan “not” setelah to be. I am not tired. She is not (isn't) here.
**Pertanyaan:** pindahkan to be ke depan subjek. Are you ready? Is he a teacher?
**Singkatan:** I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're.

**There is / There are:** There **is** a book (satu benda). There **are** three books (banyak benda).

**Kesalahan umum:** jangan memakai is/are bersama kata kerja biasa.
Salah: She is go to school. Benar: She goes to school.

**Present Simple: kebiasaan dan fakta**

Dipakai untuk kebiasaan, rutinitas, dan fakta umum.
**Rumus:** Subjek + kata kerja dasar (V1). Untuk He / She / It tambahkan **-s / -es**.
- I work. / She works.
- go → goes, watch → watches, study → studies, have → has

**Negatif:** do not (don't) / does not (doesn't) + V1. She doesn't like meat.
**Pertanyaan:** Do / Does + subjek + V1? Does he work here?

**Kata penanda:** always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day.
**Fakta:** The sun rises in the east.

**Kesalahan umum:** She don't like... (salah) → She doesn't like. / Does she goes? (salah) → Does she go?

items.lesson_explanation:
**Present Continuous: sedang berlangsung**

**Rumus:** am / is / are + kata kerja-**ing**. Dipakai untuk kejadian yang **sedang** terjadi sekarang.
- Look! It is raining now.
- I am studying at the moment.

**Kata penanda:** now, at the moment, today, these days, Look!, Listen!

**Bandingkan:**
- Present Simple = kebiasaan: I study English every day.
- Present Continuous = sedang terjadi: I am studying English now.

**Ejaan -ing:** run → running, make → making, write → writing, sit → sitting.

**Kata kerja yang tidak dipakai dalam bentuk -ing** (kata kerja keadaan): know, like, love, want, need, understand, believe.
Salah: I am knowing the answer. Benar: I know the answer.

items.explanation: Umbrella diawali bunyi vokal: an umbrella.
items.source_reference: Original lesson written for Fluento. Topic reference: Oxford Practice Grammar, Building Grammar Skills for TOEFL iBT, TOEFL structure patterns.
items.lesson_explanation:
**Artikel: a, an, the**

- **a / an** dipakai untuk benda tunggal yang belum tertentu: a book, an apple.
  - **an** sebelum **bunyi** vokal: an apple, an hour (h tidak dibunyikan), an honest man.
  - **a** sebelum bunyi konsonan: a university (dibaca "yu"), a car.
- **the** dipakai untuk benda yang sudah tertentu atau sudah diketahui kedua pihak: Close **the** door. Juga untuk benda unik (the sun, the moon) dan superlatif (the best).
- **Tanpa artikel** untuk benda jamak atau tak terhitung yang umum: I love music. Dogs are loyal. Juga nama orang, bahasa, dan olahraga: She speaks Japanese.

**Kesalahan umum:** a informations (salah) → information tidak bisa dihitung dan tidak memakai a/an.

items.lesson_explanation:
**Artikel: a, an, the**

- **a / an** dipakai untuk benda tunggal yang belum tertentu: a book, an apple.
  - **an** sebelum **bunyi** vokal: an apple, an hour (h tidak dibunyikan), an honest man.
  - **a** sebelum bunyi konsonan: a university (dibaca "yu"), a car.
- **the** dipakai untuk benda yang sudah tertentu atau sudah diketahui kedua pihak: Close **the** door. Juga untuk benda unik (the sun, the moon) dan superlatif (the best).
- **Tanpa artikel** untuk benda jamak atau tak terhitung yang umum: I love music. Dogs are loyal. Juga nama orang, bahasa, dan olahraga: She speaks Japanese.

**Kesalahan umum:** a informations (salah) → information tidak bisa dihitung dan tidak memakai a/an.

**Masa depan: will dan be going to**

**will + V1** dipakai untuk:
- keputusan spontan: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.

- rencana yang sudah diputuskan sebelumnya: We are going to visit Japan next month. (tiket sudah dibeli)

**Negatif:** will not (**won't**) + V1. / am not, is not, are not going to + V1.
Setelah will, kata kerja selalu bentuk dasar tanpa -s dan tanpa to.

items.lesson_explanation:
**Present Perfect: have / has + V3**

**Rumus:** have / has + **past participle (V3)**. Bentuk V3: go → gone, see → seen, eat → eaten, write → written, do → done, be → been. Kata kerja beraturan: V3 = V + ed.

**Dipakai untuk:**
1. Pengalaman (waktu tidak disebut): I have visited Bali.
2. Hasil sekarang dari kejadian lampau: I have lost my keys. (sekarang belum ketemu)
3. Keadaan yang berlanjut sampai sekarang dengan **for** (lama waktu) dan **since** (titik awal): I have lived here **for** five years. / **since** 2020.

**Kata penanda:** already, yet, ever, never, just, so far, for, since.

**Jangan dipakai** dengan waktu lampau tertentu (yesterday, last week, in 2019). Pakai Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.

**Rumus:** have / has + **past participle (V3)**. Bentuk V3: go → gone, see → seen, eat → eaten, write → written, do → done, be → been. Kata kerja beraturan: V3 = V + ed.

**Dipakai untuk:**
1. Pengalaman (waktu tidak disebut): I have visited Bali.
2. Hasil sekarang dari kejadian lampau: I have lost my keys. (sekarang belum ketemu)
3. Keadaan yang berlanjut sampai sekarang dengan **for** (lama waktu) dan **since** (titik awal): I have lived here **for** five years. / **since** 2020.

**Kata penanda:** already, yet, ever, never, just, so far, for, since.

**Jangan dipakai** dengan waktu lampau tertentu (yesterday, last week, in 2019). Pakai Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.

items.lesson_explanation:
**Preposisi waktu dan tempat: at, on, in**

**Waktu**
- **at** → jam dan titik waktu: at 7 pm, at noon, at night.
- **on** → hari dan tanggal: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday.
- **in** → bulan, tahun, musim, bagian hari: in July, in 2024, in summer, in the morning.

**Tempat**
- **at** → titik tertentu: at the bus stop, at the door.
- **in** → di dalam ruang atau wilayah: in the room, in Jakarta, in Indonesia.
- **on** → di atas permukaan: on the table, on the wall.

**Lainnya:** under (di bawah), next to (di sebelah), between (di antara dua), behind (di belakang), in front of (di depan).

**Kesalahan umum:** in Monday (salah) → on Monday.

items.lesson_explanation:
**Perbandingan: lebih dan paling**

**Comparative** (membandingkan dua hal) memakai **than**:
- Kata sifat pendek → **-er**: tall → taller than, cheap → cheaper than.
- Kata sifat panjang (2 suku kata ke atas) → **more**: more expensive than, more interesting than.

**Superlative** (paling) memakai **the**:
- pendek → the **-est**: the tallest, the cheapest.
- panjang → the **most**: the most expensive.

**Ejaan:** big → bigger → the biggest, happy → happier → the happiest.
**Tidak beraturan:** good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst, far → further → the furthest.
**Sama:** as + kata sifat + as. My phone is as good as yours.

**Kesalahan umum:** more taller / most easiest (salah, jangan digabung).

items.source_reference: Original lesson written for Fluento. Topic reference: Oxford Practice Grammar, Building Grammar Skills for TOEFL iBT, TOEFL structure patterns.
items.lesson_explanation:
**Modal verbs: can, could, may, might, must, should**

Modal diikuti **bentuk dasar (V1)**, tanpa to dan tanpa -s.
- **can** = bisa / boleh: She can swim.
- **could** = bisa (lampau) / sopan: When I was five, I could swim. Could you help me?
- **may** = boleh (formal) / mungkin: May I come in?
- **might** = mungkin (kemungkinan kecil): He might come, but I'm not sure.
- **must** = harus / pasti: You must wear a helmet.
- **should** = sebaiknya: You should see a doctor.

**Perhatikan:**
- **mustn't** = dilarang: You mustn't park here.
- **don't have to** = tidak perlu / tidak wajib: You don't have to come.

**Kesalahan umum:** She can speaks (salah) → She can speak. / should to go (salah) → should go.

items.stem: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
items.source_reference: Original lesson written for Fluento. Topic reference: Oxford Practice Grammar, Building Grammar Skills for TOEFL iBT, TOEFL structure patterns.
items.lesson_explanation:
**Conditional sentences: kalimat pengandaian**

**Zero conditional** (fakta umum): If + present, **present**.
- If you heat ice, it melts.

**First conditional** (kemungkinan nyata di masa depan): If + present, **will + V1**.
- If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.

**Second conditional** (khayalan atau tidak nyata sekarang): If + **past**, **would + V1**.
- If I had a car, I would drive to work.
- Dengan be, pakai **were** untuk semua subjek: If I **were** you, I would apologize.

**Ingat:** jangan memakai will di dalam klausa if. If it will rain (salah) → If it rains.
Klausa if boleh di belakang: I will stay home if it rains.
